t: This is where Gimpel Fils, the London art gallery, is associated, on Davies Street near Grosvenor Square, though the gallery was formerly located at number 30. It was founded by brothers Charles and Peter Gimpel, sons of the Parisian art dealer René Gimpel, who wrote the Diary of an Art Dealer. Charles Gimpel was an Anglo-French art dealer, gallerist and photographer. Throughout its history the gallery has kept a commitment to contemporary British and international art.
